Summary: BUG-001: Back from the order confirmation opens a review screen that lets an empty order be placed
Environment: My Demo App 1.3.0 build 244, Android 11 emulator (API 30)
Description:
*Severity:* Critical
*Steps to reproduce*
# Add any product to the cart and complete checkout (log in as bob@example.com / 10203040, any valid address, card 4111 1111 1111 1111, 12/30, 123)
# On the "Checkout Complete" screen press the Android Back button
*Expected*
The catalog (or the confirmation screen again). There must be no way back into checkout with an empty cart.
*Actual*
A "Review your order" screen opens: "No elements in the cart.", an empty delivery address and card, "DHL Standard Delivery $5.99", "Total: 0 item $5.99" and a red Place Order button that is active.
*Test case:* TC-032
*Evidence:* evidence/back-after-order-empty-cart.png

Summary: BUG-002: The review screen shows the full card number
Environment: My Demo App 1.3.0 build 244, Android 11 emulator (API 30)
Description:
*Severity:* Major
*Steps to reproduce*
# Add a product; start checkout and log in
# Enter an address; on the payment step enter card 4111 1111 1111 1111, expiry 12/30, code 123
# Tap Review Order
*Expected*
Only the last four digits of the card, for example "•••• 1111". The expiry is also usually hidden.
*Actual*
The Payment Method block shows "4111 1111 1111 1111" and "Exp: 12/30" in full.
*Test case:* TC-028
*Evidence:* evidence/review-shows-full-card-number.png

Summary: BUG-007: With the keyboard open, the address form does not scroll to the fields being filled
Environment: My Demo App 1.3.0 build 244, Android 11 emulator (API 30)
Description:
*Severity:* Minor
*Steps to reproduce*
# Start checkout and reach the address form on a phone with the on-screen keyboard (Android 11 emulator, Google keyboard)
# Type into Full Name and then Address Line 1
*Expected*
The form scrolls so that the next field (Address Line 2, City) stays visible above the keyboard.
*Actual*
Only Full Name, Address Line 1 and the top of Address Line 2 are visible; the To Payment panel and the keyboard cover the rest and the form did not scroll. Whether a person can scroll the form by hand with the keyboard open was not tested.
*Test case:* TC-024
*Evidence:* evidence/keyboard-covers-address-fields.png
